footer.en: Example generated with Bou-Trip · edit and run: node lib/render.mjs trip.example.json

note.en: Departure from Rio to China — 28h10 flight with a stopover. Arrival in Shanghai on Oct 12 at 7:55.
note.pt: Saída do Rio rumo à China — 28h10 de voo com escala. Chegada em Shanghai no dia 12/10 às 7h55.

note.en: Arrive at GRU 3h early for the international flight.
note.pt: Chegar em GRU com 3h de antecedência para o internacional.

note.en: 28h10 flight. Set your watch to Shanghai time (+11h vs Brasília).
note.pt: 28h10 de voo. Ajuste o relógio para o fuso de Shanghai (+11h vs Brasília).

note.en: Arrival at 7:55 after 28h of flying — a light acclimatization day. At night, the Bund with Pudong's lit skyline is the best welcome.
note.pt: Chegada às 7h55 após 28h de voo — dia leve de aclimatação. À noite, o Bund com o skyline de Pudong iluminado é o melhor cartão de boas-vindas.

note.en: Metro line 2 from the airport to the center (~50min, ¥40), or Maglev to Longyang + metro.
note.pt: Metrô linha 2 do aeroporto até o centro (~50min, ¥40), ou Maglev até Longyang + metrô.

note.en: Max 1-2h nap to reset your sleep. Don't sleep more or you'll be up all night.
note.pt: Cochilo de 1-2h máximo para regular o sono. Não durma mais ou vira noite.

note.en: Historic waterfront along the Huangpu River with Pudong's skyline lit across the water — iconic view.
note.pt: Calçadão histórico à beira do Huangpu com o skyline iluminado de Pudong do outro lado — vista icônica.

items.address: Zhongshan East 1st Rd, Huangpu District, Shanghai · 上海市黄浦区中山东一路

note.en: Classic Ming garden and the old bazaar around it. If you arrive early, explore before dinner.
note.pt: Jardim clássico Ming e o bazar antigo ao redor. Se chegar cedo, explore antes do jantar.

items.address: 168 Fuyou Rd, Huangpu District, Shanghai · 上海市黄浦区福佑路168号

note.en: G high-speed train from Shanghai to Beijing — 4h24 of scenic travel through the countryside.
note.pt: Trem G de alta velocidade de Shanghai a Pequim — 4h24 de viagem cênica pelo interior.

note.en: 4h24 journey, ~US$86. Metro line 2 to Hongqiao. Afternoon arrival in Beijing.
note.pt: 4h24 de viagem, ~US$86. Metrô linha 2 até Hongqiao. Chegada à tarde em Pequim.

note.en: Hotel in the center — Dongcheng or Nanluoguxiang area. Explore the historic alleys at night.
note.pt: Hotel no centro — área de Dongcheng ou Nanluoguxiang. Explore os becos históricos à noite.

note.en: Arrival day — cold-weather shopping and hutong immersion. The Wall tomorrow requires layers: beanie, gloves and thermal base layer are essential.
note.pt: Dia de chegada — compras de roupa de frio e imersão nos hutongs. A Muralha amanhã vai exigir camadas: gorro, luvas e primeira pele térmica são essenciais.

note.en: Former Bauhaus industrial zone turned galleries and street art — a light pace for the arrival day.
note.pt: Antiga zona industrial Bauhaus virada em galerias e arte urbana — ritmo leve para a chegada.

items.address: 2-4 Jiuxianqiao Rd, Chaoyang District, Beijing · 北京市朝阳区酒仙桥路2-4号

note.en: Buy HEATTECH base layer, fleece and beanie. The Wall in October has cold wind at the peaks. Nearby Decathlon has wind jackets.
note.pt: Compre 1ª pele térmica HEATTECH, fleece e gorro. A Muralha em outubro tem vento frio nos picos. Decathlon próximo tem corta-vento.

note.en: Historic gray-brick alleys. Craft beer at Arrow Factory Hutong (Great Leap Brewing).
note.pt: Becos históricos de tijolos cinzentos. Cerveja artesanal na Arrow Factory Hutong (Great Leap Brewing).

items.address: Nanluoguxiang, Dongcheng District, Beijing · 北京市东城区南锣鼓巷

note.en: Full day on the Great Wall — the only wall day, don't miss it. Mutianyu is less touristy than Badaling and has the famous toboggan descent.
note.pt: Dia inteiro na Grande Muralha — o único dia de muralha, não perca. Mutianyu é menos turístico que Badaling e tem o famoso toboggan de descida.

note.en: Restored and less touristy section. Take the cable car up, walk between towers 14-20 and take the toboggan down (1,580m slide). Transfer: DiDi or private via hotel.
note.pt: Trecho restaurado e menos turístico. Suba de teleférico, caminhe entre as torres 14-20 e desça de toboggan (trenó de 1.580m). Transfer: DiDi ou privado pelo hotel.

items.address: Mutianyu Village, Bohai Town, Huairou District, Beijing · 北京市怀柔区渤海镇慕田峪村

note.en: Siji Minfu or Dadong: well-deserved after the day of walking.
note.pt: Siji Minfu ou Dadong: merecido após o dia de caminhada.

note.en: 🐼 Panda day! Beijing Zoo has giant pandas and red pandas — plus the Summer Palace, one of China's most beautiful historic complexes.
note.pt: 🐼 Dia dos pandas! Beijing Zoo tem pandas gigantes e pandas vermelhos — além do Palácio de Verão, um dos conjuntos históricos mais bonitos da China.

text.en: 🦊🐼 Beijing Zoo — giant pandas + red pandas

note.en: Arrive early (~9h): pandas are most active during morning feeding. The red panda enclosure allows close unobstructed views.
note.pt: Chegar cedo (~9h): pandas são mais ativos durante a alimentação matinal. O recinto de pandas vermelhos permite visão desimpedida de perto.

items.address: 137 Xizhimenwai St, Xicheng District, Beijing · 北京市西城区西直门外大街137号

note.en: UNESCO — vast imperial park with Kunming Lake, Longevity Hill and the painted Long Corridor. Full afternoon.
note.pt: UNESCO — imenso parque imperial com lago Kunming, Colina da Longevidade e a Promenade pintada. Tarde inteira.

items.address: 19 Xinjiangongmen Rd, Haidian District, Beijing · 北京市海淀区新建宫门路19号

note.en: Yonghe Lama Temple in the morning, more hutongs, and some slack before tomorrow's flight to Zhangjiajie.
note.pt: Templo Yonghe (lamaísta) de manhã, mais hutongs e folga antes do voo amanhã para Zhangjiajie.

note.en: Active Tibetan Buddhist temple with the 18m Maitreya statue — carved from a single sandalwood trunk.
note.pt: Templo budista tibetano ativo com a estátua de Maitreya de 18m — esculpida de um único tronco de sândalo.

items.address: 12 Yonghegong St, Dongcheng District, Beijing · 北京市东城区雍和宫大街12号

note.en: Shichahai lakes (chic hutongs around them) and climbing the Drum Tower for a view over the neighborhood rooftops.
note.pt: Lagos de Shichahai (hutongs chiques ao redor) e subida à Torre do Tambor para vista dos telhados do bairro.

items.address: Drum Tower, Di'anmen Outer St, Dongcheng District, Beijing · 北京市东城区地安门外大街

note.en: Flight PEK→DYG: arrive at the airport 2h early. Only 2 direct flights/day — confirm the time.
note.pt: Voo PEK→DYG: chegar ao aeroporto com 2h de antecedência. Só 2 voos diretos/dia — confirme horário.

note.en: Flight from Beijing and arrival in the heart of the Avatar mountains. Hotel in Wulingyuan, near the park.
note.pt: Voo de Pequim e chegada no coração das montanhas Avatar. Hotel em Wulingyuan, perto do parque.

note.en: The only unavoidable flight in the itinerary (no viable direct train exists). Only 2 direct flights/day from PEK. Backup: fly to Changsha + 2h bullet train.
note.pt: Único voo inevitável do roteiro (não existe trem direto viável). Só 2 diretos/dia do PEK. Backup: voar a Changsha + trem-bala 2h.

note.en: Hotel in Wulingyuan (near the park). Hunan food is very spicy — say 'bù là / 不辣' for no chili.
note.pt: Hotel em Wulingyuan (perto do parque). A cozinha de Hunan é bem apimentada — diga 'bù là / 不辣' para sem pimenta.

note.en: Tianmen Mountain — the world's longest cable car (7.5km) and the Heaven's Gate arch, 999 steps above the ground.
note.pt: Tianmen Mountain — o teleférico mais longo do mundo (7,5km) e a passagem Heaven's Gate, 999 degraus acima do chão.

note.en: 7.5km cable car (the longest in the world), epic ascent. At the top: Heaven's Gate (131m arch), 999 steps and the glass cliff walkway.
note.pt: Teleférico de 7,5km (o mais longo do mundo), subida épica. No topo: Heaven's Gate (arco de 131m), 999 degraus e a trilha de vidro no penhasco.

items.address: Tianmen Mountain Cableway Station, Yongding District, Zhangjiajie · 张家界市永定区天门山索道下站

note.en: The world's tallest stilt building (Guinness). At night: 3,000 lamps + 7D holographic projections. Arch aligned with Tianmen Cave.
note.pt: O maior prédio em palafita do mundo (Guinness). À noite: 3000 lâmpadas + projeções holográficas 7D. Arco alinhado com Tianmen Cave.

items.address: Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie · 张家界市武陵源区

note.en: The national park that inspired the floating mountains of Avatar. Ticket valid for 4 days — buy on arrival or online.
note.pt: O parque nacional que inspirou as montanhas flutuantes de Avatar. Ingresso vale 4 dias — compre na chegada ou online.

note.en: Enter via Wulingyuan. Bailong Elevator (326m glass cliff elevator), Yuanjiajie (Hallelujah Mountain) and Tianzi Mountain are the highlights.
note.pt: Entrada por Wulingyuan. Bailong Elevator (326m de vidro no penhasco), Yuanjiajie (Hallelujah Mountain) e Tianzi Mountain são os destaques.

items.address: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Wulingyuan District · 张家界国家森林公园（武陵源区）

note.en: 326m glass elevator set into the cliff — goes up in ~2min. Shorter line in the morning.
note.pt: Elevador de vidro de 326m cravado no penhasco — sobe em ~2min. Fila menor pela manhã.

note.en: 🟡 Yellow Dragon Cave in the morning and Glass Bridge before catching the train to Furong in the afternoon.
note.pt: 🟡 Yellow Dragon Cave de manhã e Glass Bridge antes de pegar o trem para Furong à tarde.

note.en: One of China's largest caves: the colossal 'Dinghai Shenzhen' stalactite (19.2m), an indoor boat lake and a walk through 5 underground 'worlds'. ~1h30 visit. Taxi ~30min from Wulingyuan.
note.pt: Uma das maiores grutas da China: estalactites colossal 'Dinghai Shenzhen' (19,2m), lago interno de barco e passeio por 5 'mundos' subterrâneos. ~1h30 de visita. Táxi ~30min de Wulingyuan.

items.address: Huanglong Cave, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie · 张家界市武陵源区黄龙洞

note.en: World's longest glass bridge (430m). ⚠️ Limited slots — book online 2-7 days ahead. Passport required at entry.
note.pt: Maior ponte de vidro do mundo (430m). ⚠️ Vagas limitadas — reserve online com 2-7 dias de antecedência. Passaporte obrigatório na entrada.

items.address: Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon, Sanguansi, Cili County · 张家界慈利县三官寺大峡谷

note.en: Bullet train from Zhangjiajie West to Furongzhen. 10+ trains/day on the same line.
note.pt: Trem-bala de Zhangjiajie West até Furongzhen. 10+ trens/dia na mesma linha.

note.en: Ancient Tujia village literally built over a large waterfall. Less touristy than Fenghuang, more authentic. The must-see moment is at night, with the waterfall illuminated.
note.pt: Vila milenar Tujia construída literalmente sobre uma grande cachoeira. Menos turística que Fenghuang, mais autêntica. O momento obrigatório é à noite, com a cachoeira iluminada.

note.en: Stilt houses (diaojiaolou) over the waterfall. By day: cobblestone alleys and local vibe. At night: the waterfall is illuminated and you can walk behind the falls.
note.pt: Casario de palafita (diaojiaolou) sobre a cachoeira. De dia: becos de pedra e atmosfera local. À noite: a cachoeira é iluminada e dá pra passar por trás da queda d'água.

items.address: Furong Ancient Town (Wangcun), Yongshun County, Xiangxi · 湘西州永顺县芙蓉镇

note.en: The highlight of Furong: walking behind the illuminated waterfall at night. A one-of-a-kind experience.
note.pt: O ponto alto de Furong: caminhar por trás da queda d'água iluminada à noite. Experiência única.

note.en: Train to Guangzhou — China's gastronomic capital. Dim sum, yum cha and the Canton Tower await.
note.pt: Trem para Guangzhou — capital da gastronomia chinesa. Dim sum, yum cha e a Canton Tower esperam por vocês.

note.en: Book 1-2 weeks ahead on Trip.com. Afternoon/evening arrival.
note.pt: Compre com 1-2 semanas de antecedência no Trip.com. Chegada à tarde/noite.

note.en: Guangzhou is the birthplace of dim sum — eating here is different from anywhere else. Guangzhou Restaurant or Lianxiang Lou are classics.
note.pt: Guangzhou é a origem do dim sum — comer aqui é diferente de qualquer outro lugar. Guangzhou Restaurant ou Lianxiang Lou são clássicos.

note.en: 🐼🦊 Panda day! Chimelong Safari Park has the world's only giant panda triplets — and red pandas too. In the afternoon, the iconic Canton Tower.
note.pt: 🐼🦊 Dia de pandas! Chimelong Safari Park tem os únicos trigêmeos de panda gigante do mundo — e também pandas vermelhos. De tarde, a icônica Canton Tower.

note.en: The world's only giant panda triplets live here, in 'bamboo villas'. Red pandas also in the park. Arrive by 9h — they get drowsy after lunch. Metro line 3 to Hanxi Changlong.
note.pt: Os únicos trigêmeos de panda gigante do mundo vivem aqui, em 'villas de bambu'. Pandas vermelhos também no parque. Chegar às 9h — ficam sonolentos depois do almoço. Metrô linha 3 até Hanxi Changlong.

items.address: Changlong Wild Animal World, Panyu District, Guangzhou · 广州市番禺区长隆野生动物世界

note.en: The world's tallest tower when it opened; observation deck at 450m and the 'Sky Drop' on the edge. Pearl River night view.
note.pt: A torre mais alta do mundo quando foi inaugurada; mirante a 450m e o 'Sky Drop' na borda. Vista do rio Zhujiang à noite.

items.address: 222 Xinguang St, Haizhu District, Guangzhou · 广州市海珠区新港东路222号

note.en: A day exploring historic Guangzhou — colonial Shamian Island, the Xiguan neighborhood and Qingping Market.
note.pt: Dia de explorar a Guangzhou histórica — Shamian Island colonial, o bairro Xiguan e o Mercado Qingping.

note.en: Yum cha in Guangzhou is a cultural experience: dim sum served from trolleys at the tables, lively atmosphere, tea flows non-stop. Book early.
note.pt: Yum cha em Guangzhou é experiência cultural: dim sum servido em carrinhos nas mesas, ambiente animado, chá flui sem parar. Reserve cedo.

note.en: Franco-British colonial enclave with 19th-century mansions and giant banyan trees lining the streets. Peaceful and very photogenic.
note.pt: Ilha-enclave colonial franco-britânica com mansões do século XIX e banians gigantes nas ruas. Atmosfera tranquila e muito fotogênica.

items.address: Shamian Island, Liwan District, Guangzhou · 广州市荔湾区沙面岛

text.en: Temple of Six Banyans · Qingping Market

note.en: Active Buddhist temple (537 AD) with a 57m floral pagoda. The adjacent Qingping Market sells spices, herbs and teas — great for shopping.
note.pt: Templo budista ativo (537 d.C.) com pagode floral de 57m. O Mercado Qingping ao lado vende especiarias, ervas e chás — ótimo para compras.

items.address: 87 Liurong Rd, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou · 广州市越秀区六榕路87号

note.en: Train back to Shanghai for the final leg of the trip. At night, Pudong and the Bund one last time — always striking.
note.pt: Trem de volta a Shanghai para o fechamento da viagem. À noite, Pudong e o Bund pela última vez — sempre impactante.

note.en: G or D train from Guangzhou South to Shanghai Hongqiao, ~US$65-90. Book ahead.
note.pt: G ou D train de Guangzhou South até Shanghai Hongqiao, ~US$65-90. Compre com antecedência.

note.en: 🏯 Day trip to Suzhou — the 'Venice of the East' is 30-40min by train. The trick is arriving at the Humble Administrator's Garden before 8h, before the tour buses.
note.pt: 🏯 Bate-volta a Suzhou — a 'Veneza do Oriente' está a 30-40min de trem. O segredo é chegar no Humble Administrator's Garden antes das 8h, antes dos ônibus de turismo.

note.en: Leave early (7h30) to arrive in Suzhou by 8h and enter the garden before 10h (when tour buses arrive en masse).
note.pt: Sair cedo (7h30) para chegar em Suzhou às 8h e entrar no jardim antes das 10h (quando os ônibus de turismo chegam em massa).

note.en: The most famous classical Chinese garden (UNESCO). Design that frames the North Temple Pagoda in the background. Book via the 苏州园林 mini-program or Trip.com (opens 7 days ahead at midnight).
note.pt: O jardim clássico chinês mais famoso (UNESCO). Design que emoldura a Pagoda do Templo Norte ao fundo. Reserve pelo mini-program 苏州园林 ou Trip.com (abre 7 dias antes à meia-noite).

items.address: 178 Northeast St, Gusu District, Suzhou · 苏州市姑苏区东北街178号

note.en: Museum designed by I.M. Pei (grandson of the garden's founder next door). Architecture that dialogues with classical gardens in a contemporary language. Free.
note.pt: Museu projetado por I.M. Pei (neto do fundador do jardim ao lado). Arquitetura que dialoga com os jardins clássicos em linguagem contemporânea. Gratuito.

items.address: 204 Dongbei St, Gusu District, Suzhou · 苏州市姑苏区东北街204号

note.en: An 800-year-old historic street along the canal, with teahouses, traditional theaters and black-and-white architecture. Pingtan performances early afternoon. Buy silk: real silk smells like burnt hair and doesn't melt.
note.pt: Rua histórica de 800 anos às margens do canal, com chazeiros, teatros tradicionais e casario branco-e-preto. Performances de Pingtan no começo da tarde. Compre seda: a real cheira a cabelo queimado, não derrete.

items.address: Pingjiang Rd, Gusu District, Suzhou · 苏州市姑苏区平江路

note.en: Modern Shanghai: the French Concession with its giant plane trees and iconic cafés, Xintiandi and the riverside museums.
note.pt: Shanghai moderna: a French Concession com seus platanos gigantes e cafés icônicos, Xintiandi e os museus da margem do rio.

note.en: Tianzifang (art alley), Wukang Road (iconic colonial villa, heavily photographed) and Anfu Road (indie cafés, local fashion).
note.pt: Tianzifang (beco de arte), Wukang Road (villa colonial icônica, muito fotografada) e Anfu Road (cafés independentes, moda local).

items.address: Wukang Rd, Xuhui District, Shanghai · 上海市徐汇区武康路

note.en: Neighborhood of restored shikumen stone-gate houses. Good for drinks and outdoor dining.
note.pt: Bairro de casas shikumen restauradas. Bom para drinks e jantar ao ar livre.

items.address: 181 Taicang Rd, Huangpu District, Shanghai · 上海市黄浦区太仓路181号

note.en: Industrial warehouses converted into contemporary art galleries — the best of Shanghai's art circuit.
note.pt: Galpões industriais convertidos em galerias de arte contemporânea — o melhor do circuito de arte de Shanghai.

items.address: 50 Moganshan Rd, Putuo District, Shanghai · 上海市普陀区莫干山路50号

note.en: Zhujiajiao Water Town in the morning — a canal city 1h from Shanghai — and in the afternoon the Shanghai Museum downtown.
note.pt: Zhujiajiao Water Town de manhã — canal city a 1h de Shanghai — e à tarde o Shanghai Museum no centro.

note.en: A 1,700-year-old water town with 36 stone bridges and canals. Within Shanghai. Bus 1000 from Pu'an Rd or organized tour.
note.pt: Water town de 1700 anos com 36 pontes de pedra e canais. Dentro de Shanghai. Ônibus 1000 de Pu'an Rd ou tour organizado.

items.address: Zhujiajiao, Qingpu District, Shanghai · 上海市青浦区朱家角镇

note.en: One of the world's best collections of Chinese art and artifacts. Free. Bronze collection, Song ceramics and imperial paintings.
note.pt: Uma das melhores coleções de arte e artefatos chineses do mundo. Gratuito. Coleção de bronzes, cerâmica Song e pinturas imperiais.

items.address: 201 Renmin Ave, Huangpu District, Shanghai · 上海市黄浦区人民大道201号

note.en: Final shopping and buffer day. The Shanghai Tower at night closes the trip perfectly — 118th floor, the highest view in China.
note.pt: Compras finais e dia-colchão. A Shanghai Tower à noite fecha a viagem com chave de ouro — 118º andar, a vista mais alta da China.

text.en: 🛍️ Final shopping — Nanjing Rd / IFC / Huaihai Rd
text.pt: 🛍️ Compras finais — Nanjing Rd / IFC / Huaihai Rd

note.en: Electronics and gadgets on Huaihai Rd. Fine teas at Tianshan Tea City. Souvenirs at Yuyuan Bazaar.
note.pt: Eletrônicos e gadgets em Huaihai Rd. Chás finos em Tianshan Tea City. Lembranças em Yuyuan Bazaar.

note.en: 118th floor, 561m — China's highest observation deck. At night the Pudong lights and the Bund are unforgettable. Book online to skip the line.
note.pt: 118º andar, 561m — o mirante mais alto da China. À noite as luzes de Pudong e o Bund são inesquecíveis. Reserve online para evitar fila.

items.address: 501 Yincheng Middle Rd, Pudong, Shanghai · 上海市浦东新区银城中路501号

note.en: Return day — check-out and airport. The 7-minute Maglev at 430km/h is the perfect final experience.
note.pt: Dia de volta — check-out e aeroporto. O Maglev de 7min a 430km/h é a experiência final perfeita.

note.en: Maglev train: 7min at 430km/h from downtown to the airport. Worth the experience — ¥50.
note.pt: Trem de levitação magnética: 7min a 430km/h do centro ao aeroporto. Vale a experiência — ¥50.

note.en: Arrive at the airport 3h+ early. Arrival in Rio on Nov 1 at 6:50.
note.pt: Chegar ao aeroporto com 3h+ de antecedência. Chegada no Rio em 01/11 às 6:50.
